title: pvVisItChomboReader
body:
## pvVisItChomboReader

Reads HDF5 plotfiles from the Chombo block-structured adaptive mesh refinement framework (LBNL). With only the AMR mesh selected the output is vtkOverlappingAMR (patches on refinement levels); with other meshes selected it is a multiblock dataset. ParaView 5.13.3 has no native Chombo reader; AMReX/BoxLib plotfiles should use pvAMReXBoxLibGridReader instead. FileName takes a list of files, each one time step of a series (ParaView's file-series wrapper).

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- AMR output suits AMR-aware operations; use pvConvertAMRdatasettoMultiblock or merge before operations that need ordinary datasets, and remember coarse cells under finer patches overlap them.
- Name the arrays you need in PointArrayStatus and CellArrayStatus (materials in MaterialStatus): the VisIt bridge starts with every variable unselected, so omitting them normally gives geometry without fields.
- The VisIt plugin's own read options stay at their defaults; the ParaView proxy exposes no property to change them.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue and has not run a native acceptance check for this reader; check meshes, arrays and times on your own data.

Native constructor: `VisItChomboReader`. Identity: `sources/VisItChomboReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrayStatus` | Names of the zone-centred (cell) variables to read from Chombo data; each becomes a cell-data array on every selected mesh that defines it. Vector variables arrive as one multi-component array, while VisIt expressions and tensor, label, species and array variables are not converted by the bridge. The Chombo plugin offers the solution components stored in the HDF5 file (normally cell-centred); which of them appear here depends on how each is centred in the file. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `MaterialStatus` | Names of materials to convert into volume-fraction cell arrays. For each selected material the bridge adds a float cell array named after it: 1 in cells made only of that material, its volume fraction in mixed cells and -1 where it is absent. The Chombo plugin offers material volume fractions when the file provides them. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `MeshStatus` | Names of the Chombo meshes to read. Each selected mesh becomes one named block of the multiblock output and unlisted meshes are skipped. The Chombo plugin reports the AMR mesh "Mesh" (patches grouped by refinement level) and, when present, particle meshes. Selecting only the AMR mesh makes the bridge output a vtkOverlappingAMR dataset; otherwise each selected mesh becomes a multiblock child. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointArrayStatus` | Names of the node-centred (point) variables to read from Chombo data; each becomes a point-data array on every selected mesh that defines it. Vector variables arrive as one multi-component array, while VisIt expressions and tensor, label, species and array variables are not converted by the bridge. The Chombo plugin offers the solution components stored in the HDF5 file (normally cell-centred); which of them appear here depends on how each is centred in the file. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvVisItChomboReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
